_about: Closed-class words of each language (articles, prepositions, conjunctions, pronouns, forms of 'to be' and 'to have'), for keyword extraction (cartolex.lexicon.noun_phrases.closed_words). A tagger for another language may take them for nouns when text in this language reaches its stream: a paragraph whose phrases hold two different closed words of another language is read as that language, and there these words break phrases; a phrase that starts or ends with one is set aside. Only a word written in lower case or in capitals counts: a capitalised one begins a name (La Niña). Never a content word, and no word that is a common content word or a chemical symbol in another of these languages (car, son, os, an, au, ce, ni, se, na, al, be, it, est, el, sem, tem): the lists are filters, not keywords.
